issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: x1
products.tagline: Lovable for iPhone apps go from idea to App Store
products.summaryZh: Lovable让iPhone应用从创意直达App Store
products.descriptionZh: X1是一款AI应用构建工具，帮助您从创意到可在App Store发布的iPhone应用。它并非试图通过单一提示生成整个应用，而是逐步引导您完成。X1会提出针对性的问题，设计每个屏幕供您审阅和编辑，然后分阶段构建应用。您可以随时在iPhone上预览和测试。准备就绪后，X1会为您准备App Store列表、截图和提交材料。无需编写代码。
products.description: X1 is an AI app builder that takes you from an idea to an iPhone app you can publish on the App Store. Instead of trying to generate the entire app from one prompt, X1 guides you step by step. It asks focused questions, designs each screen for you to review and edit, then builds the app in stages. Preview and test it on your iPhone as you go. When it’s ready, X1 prepares your App Store listing, screenshots, and submission. No coding required.

products.name: Expertise AI
products.tagline: Turn your GTM skills into recurring revenue
products.summaryZh: 将你的GTM技能转化为经常性收入
products.descriptionZh: Expertise AI是GTM专家将其手册变现为受保护AI技能的平台。每位专家拥有一个店面，企业可在其中试用并按订阅方式安装这些技能，每次运行专家即可获得报酬。
products.description: Expertise AI is where GTM experts monetize their playbooks as protected Al skills. Each expert gets a storefront where businesses demo and install these skills on a subscription, and gets paid every time one runs.

products.name: PostHog Desktop
products.tagline: The product editor for product builders
products.summaryZh: 面向产品构建者的产品编辑器
products.descriptionZh: 一个为你的团队和智能代理打造的多人在线工作空间——以你的产品数据为背景，借助PostHog工具进行发布和度量。构建并编辑你的产品 | 运行一组智能代理 | 将产品信号转化为PR。
products.description: A multiplayer workspace for you, your team, and your agents – with your product data as context, and PostHog tools to ship and measure. Build and edit your product | Run a fleet of agents | Turn product signals into PRs.

products.name: ChatCut Desktop
products.tagline: Video editor built for humans & AI. Edit with GPT & Claude.
products.summaryZh: 为人类与AI打造的视频编辑器。与GPT和Claude一同编辑。
products.descriptionZh: ChatCut Desktop 是一款为人类与智能体协作剪辑而打造的 AI 视频编辑器。您可以使用 ChatCut 内置的智能体，或连接 ChatGPT/Codex 或 Claude Code。只需描述您想要的视频编辑效果，即可在完全可编辑的时间线上实时呈现。编辑素材、创建动态图形和字幕、生成视频、图片、音乐和音效，并保存可复用的编辑技能。所有操作均在本地运行，您始终掌控一切。支持将 XML 导出至 Premiere Pro、DaVinci Resolve 或 CapCut。
products.description: Introducing ChatCut Desktop, the AI video editor built for humans and agents to edit together. Use ChatCut’s built-in agent, or connect ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code. Say how you want your video edited and watch them happen on a fully editable timeline. Edit footage, create motion graphics and captions, generate video, images, music and SFX, and save reusable editing skills. Everything runs locally, and you stay in control. Export XML to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

products.name: MCP-Builder.ai
products.tagline: The fastest way to connect your data with your AI Tools.
products.summaryZh: 连接数据与AI工具的最快方式。
products.descriptionZh: 几分钟内构建一个托管且安全的MCP服务器。将MCP-Builder.ai视为MCP连接器的Lovable。描述你想连接的内容，它会为你构建、托管并保护你的MCP服务器。无需部署、基础设施或安全设置。连接：• 数据库 • API • 第三方应用 • 文件 • 以及更多。获取你的MCP URL，将其添加到Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor或任何兼容MCP的客户端，即可开始使用。
products.description: Build a hosted and secured MCP Server in minutes. Think of MCP-Builder.ai as Lovable for MCP connectors. Describe what you want to connect and it builds, hosts and secures your MCP Server for you. No deployment, infrastructure or security setup needed. Connect: • Databases • APIs • 3rd party apps • Files • And more Get your MCP URL, add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP compatible client and start using it.

products.name: Tellie Prompter 1.5
products.tagline: The teleprompter that knows what you haven't said
products.summaryZh: 知道你还未说出口的提词器
products.descriptionZh: 大多数提词器让你跟着它走，Tellie却跟着你。它聆听你实际说出的话语，让你可以停顿、跳过、即兴发挥或脱离脚本而不迷失位置。现在Tellie 1.5还能预知你尚未说出的内容。它追踪你的重点，提醒你是否超时，并总结你的表现。这一切都集成在一款3MB的Mac应用中，本地运行，无需账户，无遥测数据。免费使用10天，ProductHunt用户凭代码PRODHUNT10可享10美元优惠。
products.description: Most teleprompters make you follow them. Tellie follows you. It listens to the words you actually say, so you can pause, skip, improvise, or go off script without losing your place. Now Tellie 1.5 knows what you haven’t said yet, too. It tracks your important points, warns when you’re running long, and debriefs your take. All in a 3 MB Mac app that runs locally, with no account and no telemetry. Free for 10 days and $10 off for ProductHunt with code PRODHUNT10

products.name: OpenComputer
products.tagline: Firebase for Agents
products.summaryZh: Firebase for Agents
products.descriptionZh: 介绍OpenComputer 将您的智能体部署为函数。为其配备一台计算机。- 每个会话一台真实的Linux机器 - 支持ffmpeg、chromium、git，可安装任何软件 - 持久化：休眠与恢复 - 您的密钥永不进入运行时 过去十年的云是为应用而建。下一个十年则是为万亿级常驻智能体而生。OpenComputer是它们的家园。
products.description: Introducing OpenComputer Deploy your agent as a function. Get a computer for it. - a real Linux machine per session - ffmpeg, chromium, git, install anything - durable: hibernate + resume - your keys never enter the runtime The cloud of the last decade was built for apps. The next one is for trillions of always on agents. OpenComputer is their home.

products.name: Mac mini
products.tagline: Now with M6 and M5 Pro chips
products.summaryZh: 现在搭载M6和M5 Pro芯片
products.descriptionZh: Mac mini现搭载M6和M5 Pro芯片，带来更快的性能、Apple Intelligence、Wi-Fi 7及更快的存储速度，应用于苹果紧凑型5英寸桌面设备。专为编程、创作及高效工作而设计。
products.description: Mac mini now comes with M6 and M5 Pro, bringing faster performance, Apple Intelligence, Wi-Fi 7, and faster storage to Apple's compact 5-inch desktop. Built for coding, creating, and getting work done.

products.name: ify
products.tagline: Resolution AI that works on top of your existing helpdesk
products.summaryZh: 基于现有帮助台运行的Resolution AI
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI支持工具要求你先拆除帮助台。Ify则能在Freshdesk、Zendesk、Salesforce或HubSpot之上运行，并跨电子邮件、聊天、WhatsApp、Slack等渠道工作。通常阻碍AI支持部署的部分是“我们的文档不够好”。Ify通过构建自己的知识库来解决这个问题：它抓取你的网站和文档，从发布说明和过往工单解决记录中生成标准操作流程。专为希望立即投入使用的支持团队而设计。
products.description: Most AI support tools ask you to rip out your helpdesk first. Ify works on top of Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce, or HubSpot and gets to work across email, chat, WhatsApp, Slack, and more. The part that usually stalls an AI support rollout is "our docs aren't good enough." Ify solves that by building its own knowledge base: it scrapes your site and docs, generates SOPs from release notes and past ticket resolutions. Built for support teams who want something live now.

products.name: Evidence Core
products.tagline: Build live analytics with coding agents
products.summaryZh: 使用编码代理构建实时分析
products.descriptionZh: Evidence Core是一个开源框架，用于通过编码代理构建商业智能应用。将整个商业智能平台构建为文件仓库，并可免费部署到任何地方。指标、仪表板、报告和主题均以代码形式定义，您可以使用Evidence CLI进行验证、预览和服务。
products.description: Evidence Core is an open source framework for building business intelligence applications with coding agents. Build your entire business intelligence platform as a repo of files, and deploy it anywhere, for free. Metrics, dashboards, reports and themes are all specified in code which you can validate, preview and serve using the Evidence CLI.

products.name: Lore Machine
products.tagline: Substack For World Builders
products.summaryZh: 面向世界构建者的Substack
products.descriptionZh: 新创作者登场：世界构建师。凭借人类已知的最先进可视化技术，世界构建师一次一个连载故事地创造多媒体宇宙。但Instagram、TikTok和YouTube并非为承载这些而生。在Lore Machine上，世界构建师将文字转化为可滚动的多媒体冒险，称为LORE，再将LORE连载成拥有稳定角色、正典和叙事物理的世界。如今，他们可以出售进入自己世界的门票。
products.description: There's a new creator in town: The World Builder. Armed with the most advanced visualization technology known to man, World Builders conjure multimedia universes one serialized story at a time. But Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube weren't built to hold them. On Lore Machine, World Builders turn text into scrollable multimedia adventures called LORE, then serialize LOREs into a World with solid state characters, canon and narrative physics. Today, they can sell tickets to their World.

products.name: Screenify Studio
products.tagline: Polished product demos on Mac recorded by an AI agent
products.summaryZh: 由AI代理在Mac上录制的精致产品演示
products.descriptionZh: Screenify Studio 是一款 Mac 屏幕录制工具，可将粗糙的录制内容转化为精致的产品演示，无需繁琐剪辑。用简单英文描述演示场景，AI 会驱动真实浏览器进行录制，并添加电影级 3D 镜头移动、聚光灯和标注。若偏好完全掌控，可使用带手动缩放关键帧的深度编辑器。将录制内容置于逼真的 3D MacBook、iPhone 或 iPad 中，添加设备端 AI 字幕，或通过 Claude Code 等代理可运行的命令行界面全程操控。免费起步。
products.description: Screenify Studio is a Mac screen recorder that turns rough recordings into polished product demos — without the editing tax. Describe a demo in plain English and an AI drives a real browser to record it, then adds cinematic 3D camera moves, spotlights, and callouts. Prefer full control? A deep editor with manual zoom keyframes. Stage recordings in a photoreal 3D MacBook, iPhone, or iPad, add on-device AI captions, or drive it all from a CLI an agent like Claude Code can run. Free to start.

products.name: Playcall
products.tagline: The open-source AI alternative to Gong
products.summaryZh: 开源AI替代方案，对标Gong
products.descriptionZh: Playcall是Gong的开源替代方案，专为AI原生的GTM团队打造。根据你的销售手册和销售代表面对的买家背景，为每通电话打分。支持MEDDPICC、BANT、SPIN，或上传你的销售手册，让AI生成评分标准。获取基于证据的评分、遗漏时刻和结果追踪。每个评分都附带一个供销售代表下次执行的辅导练习。可自托管。无锁定，无每年3万美元的合同，也没有10多个你团队从不使用的内置功能。
products.description: Playcall is the open-source alternative to Gong, built for AI-native GTM teams. Score every call against your playbook and the buyer context your rep was talking to. Works with MEDDPICC, BANT, SPIN, or upload your playbook and let AI generate the rubric. Get evidence-backed scores, missed moments, and outcome tracking. Every score comes with a coaching drill for the rep to run next. Self-hostable. No lock-in, no $30K/year contracts, or 10+ baked-in features your team never touches.

products.name: EasySwitch
products.tagline: One mouse, keyboard and second screen for all your computers
products.summaryZh: 一个鼠标、键盘和第二个屏幕，掌控你的所有电脑。
products.descriptionZh: 现有工具让你做出选择。软件KVM（如Synergy、Deskflow、Mouse Without Borders）共享鼠标和键盘，但不传输视频。第二屏幕应用（如Duet、spacedesk、Luna）将闲置设备变为显示器，但不共享输入。EasySwitch两者兼备：将光标滑过电脑，随处输入和粘贴，拖拽文件，并将桌面扩展到旁边的设备。加密对所有用户免费，而非额外收费。支持Wayland。原生Rust编写，无Electron——空闲时仅占用19 MB内存。
products.description: Existing tools make you choose. Software KVMs (Synergy, Deskflow, Mouse Without Borders) share your mouse and keyboard but carry no video. Second-screen apps (Duet, spacedesk, Luna) turn a spare machine into a monitor but share no input. EasySwitch does both: slide your cursor across computers, type and paste anywhere, drag files, and extend your desktop onto the machine next to you. Encryption is free for everyone, not an upsell. Wayland works. Native Rust, no Electron - 19 MB of RAM idle.

products.name: LoupeKit
products.tagline: See what any page is built with and how much of it is AI
products.summaryZh: 查看任何页面的构建方式及其AI含量。
products.descriptionZh: 面向已打开页面的开发者检查器。它能识别页面背后的技术并展示每项技术的证据，提取调色板、字体和资源，并评估页面内容中有多少看起来像原始AI输出。当你请求时，它会读取一个标签页。
products.description: A developer's inspector for the page you already have open. It names the technologies behind it and shows the evidence for each, extracts the palette, fonts and assets, and scores how much of the page reads as raw AI output. It reads one tab, when you ask.

products.name: Arena Agent Mode with GitHub
products.tagline: Get real work done, moving from idea to shipping in minutes
products.summaryZh: 快速完成实际工作，从构思到交付只需几分钟。
products.descriptionZh: 要让编码代理真正发挥作用，它必须存在于工作发生的地方：GitHub。通过直接与GitHub集成，并复用Agent Mode的基础设施，我们打造了一种无缝体验，让你无需离开浏览器，即可连接仓库、完成编码任务并推送结果。
products.description: For a coding agent to be truly useful, it needs to live where the work is: on GitHub. By integrating directly with GitHub and reusing the underlying infrastructure of Agent Mode, we’ve created a seamless experience that allows you to connect a repo, complete a coding task, and push the results—all without leaving your browser.

products.name: Warren
products.tagline: Infrastructure for coding-agent workloads
products.summaryZh: 面向编码代理工作负载的基础设施
products.descriptionZh: Warren将代理工具包作为隔离、可观测的工作负载，运行在您控制的基础设施上。它负责管理工作区、限制、实时事件、恢复和Git交付。
products.description: Warren runs agent harnesses as isolated, observable workloads on infrastructure you control. It owns the workspace, limits, live events, recovery, and Git delivery.

products.name: DeployHermes
products.tagline: Hire persistent Hermes agents with roles, memory + skills
products.summaryZh: 雇佣具备角色、记忆与技能的持久Hermes代理。
products.descriptionZh: 雇佣具备角色、模型、记忆和技能的持久Hermes AI机器人。一键进入私有运行时——每次运行都包含任务、集成和收据。将其与你的Claude Code、Codex集成，让代理管理你的机器人，进而无缝管理你的工作。
products.description: Hire persistent Hermes AI bots with a role, model, memory and skills. One click to a private runtime — missions, integrations, and receipts on every run. Integrate this with your Claude Code, Codex, and let the agents manage your bots and then your work seamlessly.

products.name: Termy
products.tagline: Learn languages from games, videos, and websites
products.summaryZh: 从游戏、视频和网站中学习语言
products.descriptionZh: Termy将你喜爱的游戏、视频和网站转化为语言练习。按下一个快捷键，它就能识别屏幕上的难词，结合上下文解释，并连同你发现它们的确切时刻一起保存——不打断你的节奏。之后，这些时刻会转化为围绕你的词汇量定制的适应性练习。支持Windows和macOS，覆盖30种语言。免费开始使用。
products.description: Termy turns the games, videos, and websites you love into language practice. Press one shortcut and it finds the difficult words on your screen, explains them in context, and saves them with the exact moment you discovered them—without breaking your flow. Later, those moments become adaptive exercises built around your vocabulary. Works on Windows and macOS in 30 languages. Free to start.

products.name: HEVN U.S.
products.tagline: Hold USD and pay globally through U.S. sponsor banks
products.summaryZh: 持有美元，通过美国合作银行全球支付。
products.descriptionZh: HEVN美国账户让100多个国家的合格企业通过美国合作银行获得美元银行服务。通过Fedwire接收美元、持有美元、向美国交易对手方本地付款，并在一个平台上结算支持的SWIFT支付。专为进口商、出口商、大宗商品交易商、制造商及其他全球企业设计，这些企业的货物运输和运营无法等待缓慢的支付链条。
products.description: HEVN U.S. Accounts give eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD banking through U.S. sponsor banks. Receive USD via Fedwire, hold USD, pay U.S. counterparties locally, and settle supported SWIFT payments from one platform. Built for importers, exporters, commodity traders, manufacturers, and other global businesses whose shipments and operations cannot wait for slow payment chains.
